nodes.description: Public Deployment struct holding cause, wallets, splits, secrets, value per entry and phase timestamps.
Public mapping address => Participant storing each participant message and entry count.
Private array of Fund records with cumulative entry counts, used for participant selection.
Private State struct tracking secrets, messages, withdrawals, participants, entries, cancellation and reveal block data.
Constructor validating deployment parameters and writing the Deployment struct; stores msg.sender as owner.
View function returning the post-deployment fundraiser state.
View function computing the caller's withdrawable balance using splits and entry totals.
Cause-only function seeding the cause secret to start the fundraiser during the participation phase.
Payable participation entry point that records a participant message and calls _raise.
Private helper converting msg.value into entries, updating totals and refunding the remainder.
Payable fallback accepting additional ether for existing participants and forwarding to _raise.
Cause-only recap-phase function revealing the cause message and storing the reveal block number.
Private view validating a message against a secret via keccak256(message, msg.sender).
Owner-only recap-phase function selecting a participant pseudo-randomly from blockhash entropy.
Private view performing a binary search over the funds array to map an entry to a participant.
Cancels the fundraiser before selection; publicly callable only after the expire time.
Withdraws the caller's balance, marking cause/participant/owner as withdrawn or zeroing refunded entries.
Owner-only selfdestruct after the destruction phase, sending remaining funds to msg.sender.
Owner-only rescue of ERC20 tokens accidentally sent to the contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, participation records and payout targets.
block.timestamp used by phase modifiers and the constructor to gate behaviour.
msg.sender.transfer(_refund) external send performed inside _raise with state already updated.
_wallet.transfer(_balance) external send executed in withdraw after flag updates.
selfdestruct(msg.sender) destroying the contract after the destruction phase.
External ERC20 transfer call whose boolean result is required, in recover.
Multiplication _state._entries * deployment._valuePerEntry * _split / 1000 in balance().
Split sum _causeSplit + _participantSplit + _ownerSplit checked against 1000 in the constructor.
Entry accumulations _participant._entries += _entries and _state._entries += _entries in _raise.
Weak randomness via blockhash(_state._revealBlockNumber) fed into keccak256 in end().
Constructor parameter _cause: address of the cause.
Constructor parameter _causeWallet: payout wallet for the cause.
Constructor parameter _causeSplit: cause share out of 1000.
Constructor parameter _participantSplit: selected participant share out of 1000.
Constructor parameter _ownerWallet: payout wallet for the owner.
Constructor parameter _ownerSplit: owner share out of 1000.
Constructor parameter _ownerSecret: secret used later by end().
Constructor parameter _valuePerEntry: wei price of a single entry.
Constructor parameter _endTime: end of the participation phase.
Constructor parameter _expireTime: end of the recap phase.
Constructor parameter _destructTime: start of the destruction phase.
Constructor parameter _entropy: number of random-selection iterations in end().
begin() parameter _secret seeding the cause secret.
participate() parameter _message stored for the participant.
_raise() storage reference to the caller's Participant record.
reveal() parameter _message validated then stored as the cause message.
_decode() parameter _secret compared against the hash.
_decode() parameter _message hashed with msg.sender.
end() parameter _message used as owner message and randomness seed.
_findParticipant() parameter _entry locating a participant by cumulative entries.
recover() parameter _token: ERC20 token contract address to rescue from.
balance() local _split holding the applicable split for the caller role.
balance() local Participant storage reference used during cancellation refunds.
_raise() returned local _entries computed from msg.value.
_raise() returned local _refund: remainder wei returned to the sender.
_raise() local _previousFundEntries: cumulative entries of the last fund.
_raise() memory local _fund newly pushed onto the funds array.
end() local _randomNumber produced by keccak256 over entropy sources.
end() local _participant selected by the randomness loop.
end() local _participantMessage used as additional entropy.
end() local _entry derived modulo _state._entries.
end() loop counter i bounded by deployment._entropy.
_findParticipant() local left bound of the binary search.
_findParticipant() local right bound of the binary search.
_findParticipant() local midpoint index.
_findParticipant() local index following the midpoint.
_findParticipant() local copy of the midpoint fund.
_findParticipant() local copy of the next fund.
withdraw() local _balance returned by balance().
withdraw() local _wallet chosen as payout destination.
withdraw() local Participant storage reference zeroed on refund.
recover() local _erc20 token interface bound to the supplied address.
recover() local _balance of tokens held by this contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as deployment._owner, making the constructor caller the privileged owner.
balance() branches on msg.sender to decide the applicable split, so callers can influence payout amounts.
begin() is restricted by onlyCause which compares msg.sender to deployment._cause.
participate() keys the participant record on msg.sender and is payable.
_raise() pushes a fund for msg.sender and refunds msg.sender directly.
fallback loads participants[msg.sender] and forwards the caller to _raise.
reveal() is onlyCause and _decode hashes msg.sender into the comparison.
_decode() binds the caller into keccak256(_message, msg.sender).
end() is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to deployment._owner.
cancel() treats msg.sender as owner/cause or member of the community per phase rules.
withdraw() selects the payout and zeroes state based on msg.sender before sending funds.
destroy() is onlyOwner and selfdestructs to msg.sender.
recover() is onlyOwner, restricting token rescue to the deployment owner.
Refund value is transferred to the untrusted msg.sender.
Withdrawal balance is transferred to an address derived from msg.sender.
selfdestruct target is msg.sender.
Constructor requires phase timestamps to be strictly greater than now, so deployment depends on block.timestamp.
participationPhase modifier gates begin() on now < deployment._endTime.
participationPhase modifier gates participate() on block.timestamp.
participationPhase modifier gates the payable fallback on block.timestamp.
recapPhase modifier gates reveal() on now being between end and expire times.
recapPhase modifier gates end() on block.timestamp.
cancel() lets the public act only when now is within the expire-to-destruct window.
destructionPhase modifier gates destroy() on now >= deployment._destructTime.
Constructor writes the whole Deployment struct, including msg.sender and now.
Constructor sums the three splits and compares the result to 1000; unchecked adds can overflow.
balance() reads _state._participant, cancellation flags and entry totals.
balance() reads deployment splits, value per entry and owner/cause addresses.
balance() reads participants[msg.sender]._entries in the cancelled branch.
Balance computation multiplies entries by value per entry and a split percentage.
state() reads every field of the _state struct.
state() reads participants[_participant]._message.
begin() checks and writes _state._causeSecret.
participate() reads deployment phase data via modifiers.
participate() reads and writes the participants mapping for msg.sender.
participate() checks _state._causeSecret and _state._cancelled and increments _state._participants.
participate() delegates entry accounting to _raise().
_raise() reads deployment._valuePerEntry to convert wei into entries.
_raise() increments the stored participant entry count.
_raise() appends a new cumulative Fund to the funds array.
_raise() increments _state._entries.
_raise() sends the partial-entry refund to msg.sender via transfer.
_raise() adds entries to participant and global counters without overflow checks.
fallback reads deployment phase state through modifiers.
fallback requires participants[msg.sender]._message to be set.
fallback checks _state._cancelled and _state._causeSecret.
fallback forwards the contribution to _raise().
reveal() writes _state._causeMessage and _state._revealBlockNumber.
reveal() validates the cause message through _decode().
end() reads deployment._ownerSecret, _entropy and owner address.
end() reads participants[_participant]._message for entropy.
end() reads and writes cause message, reveal block data, owner message and selected participant.
end() validates the owner message through _decode().
end() maps the derived entry to a participant via _findParticipant().
end() derives randomness from blockhash and participant messages.
_findParticipant() binary searches the funds array.
cancel() compares msg.sender with deployment owner, cause and expire time.
cancel() checks _state._participant and sets _state._cancelled.
withdraw() reads deployment wallets and owner/cause addresses.
withdraw() zeroes participants[msg.sender]._entries on refund.
withdraw() reads and sets participant/withdrawn/cancelled state.
withdraw() calls balance() to compute the amount to pay out.
withdraw() transfers the computed balance to the resolved wallet.
destroy() calls selfdestruct to remove the contract.
recover() reads deployment._owner as the token recipient.
recover() invokes the external ERC20 transfer on the supplied token.
Refund transfer to msg.sender can re-enter the payable fallback of this contract.
Balance transfer to msg.sender can re-enter the payable fallback before the call returns.
